subject.title: feat: configure metadata (contextWindow, maxTokens, etc.) for custom provider setup

question: After the metadata-preservation fixes, should OpenClaw accept this configure-time custom-provider metadata editor in core, or defer the interactive flow to the canonical onboarding metadata issue?
rationale: The code defects are mechanical, but the permanent setup surface overlaps an open product-direction issue and affects persisted provider/model config.

options.title: Repair and accept configure-only flow
options.body: Fix the metadata preservation bugs, keep this scoped to custom-provider `configure --section model`, and leave broader onboarding/non-interactive work tracked separately.

options.title: Pause for unified onboarding design
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers decide one shared model-metadata setup path across configure, onboard, and non-interactive flows.

options.title: Close in favor of canonical issue
options.body: If maintainers do not want this surface in core, close this PR and continue product discussion on the canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Repair and accept configure-only flow
recommendation.body: Fix the metadata preservation bugs, keep this scoped to custom-provider `configure --section model`, and leave broader onboarding/non-interactive work tracked separately.
